skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Analyze and evaluate the organizational structure, functions, customer market; describe the work, operational processes, and specific activities of the operations units: design, program management, and tour guiding.

Practicing soft skills such as communicating with company departments, customers, problem-solving skills to gather basic information about the company and data to analyze operational processes and activities of the design, management, and tour guiding units.

Analyze situations, adapt, and update knowledge in the travel industry. Ensure health, ethical standards, awareness, responsibility, and requirements of design, management, and tour guiding operations. Maintain a serious attitude during the learning process, actively participate in environmental and social protection activities, and preserve cultural and national traditions.

Analyze the activities of product design at the company: organizational structure and function of the product design department/person, job description and design process, current customers, programs offered, and software/systems used.

Analyze the activities of program management at the company: organizational structure and function of the program management department/person, job description and management process, supplier network, and software/systems used.

Analyze the activities of guiding at the company: organizational structure and function of the guiding department/person, guiding job description, guiding process, guiding requirements, and handling real-life situations.
Analyze situations, communicate friendly and harmoniously with company departments and customers, and solve problems posed by the company.
Analyze, observe, search for information, and interview about the operational activities of the design, management, and guiding units.

Be aware of adapting, integrating, and updating knowledge in the travel industry. Ensure health, ethical standards, awareness, responsibility, and requirements of design, management, and tour guiding operations. Maintain a serious attitude during the learning process, actively participate in environmental and social protection activities, and preserve cultural and national traditions.
